raw_response:
This is my small perennial plot near the house, probably enset or coffee with some intercrops. I have no money to waste on chemical fertilizer for a plot this small, and these crops do best with the manure from my animals and household waste anyway, like my father taught me. I use the seedlings and suckers I have from my own plants — that is what everyone here does. Since it is only a small piece, my family and I can manage the weeding and harvest ourselves without hiring anyone.
